frequency_question: How often does a besieged state successfully localize complex missile production?
membership_rule: Includes states that initiated and operationalized domestic final assembly or component manufacturing of major foreign-designed guided missiles while under active foreign invasion.

cases.name: United Kingdom domestic production of US/foreign aviation and ordnance (World War II)
Taiwan domestic production of Hsiung Feng missile series (initiated under isolation/threat)
Ukraine domestic adaptation and scaling of Neptune missile systems post-2014/2022

provenance_note: 3 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.7x)
coverage_note: 3 named; believed roughly 5 in total globally meeting strict high-tech wartime missile localization criteria
known_gaps: Extremely sparse population due to the rarity of states having both the prior industrial base and surviving active invasion long enough to complete complex missile lines.
skeleton: Cases of states under severe military constraint attempting technology transfer and domestic manufacture of precision strike weapons
multiplier: 3 observed successful precedents out of 5 major historical attempts where a state attempted localized production of high-tech guided weapons under external threat
validity_reason: Industrial and technological transfer constraints for complex missiles change slowly relative to decade-long technological epochs.
